**Finding: Compliant** (no redline)

The Agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity, field-of-use or territory restriction on AP. Section 1 (p0001) does the opposite — it expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms AP remains free to offer Inventory via other agents or sell to third parties. That sits at the playbook's **preferred** position.

Checks run: "compet" (only "competent"/"competent jurisdiction"), "exclusiv" (non-exclusive licence grant, exclusive jurisdiction, IP ownership, entire-agreement, third-party-beneficiary — none restrictive of AP), and "shall not" (Kubient IP warranties, AP creative/content standards, indemnity notice, assignment consent). No covenant binds AP's lines of business.
